# openinfra_vpc_endpoint (Resource)

A private, in-VPC entry point to an AWS service (the AWS VPC endpoint analog): a stable DNS alias to the aws-shim front door that a workload uses as its AWS endpoint URL. All services route to the shim; `service`/`vpc_endpoint_type` are carried for fidelity (CFN round-trip). Requires the kube-ovn CNI + the aws-shim.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `service` (String) AWS service the endpoint fronts (s3, dynamodb, sqs, sns, kms, …). Selects the endpoint's purpose; all route to the aws-shim.

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `vpc` (String) The kind: Vpc this endpoint serves (fidelity / owning VPC). The alias is created in the claim's namespace.
- `vpc_endpoint_type` (String) AWS endpoint type — `Interface` (PrivateLink, default) or `Gateway` (S3/DynamoDB in AWS). Fidelity; both route to the shim here.

### Read-Only

- `dns_name` (String) The in-cluster DNS name to set as the AWS endpoint URL for this service.
- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.
